lines.text: Jesus went through all the towns and villages, teaching in their synagogues and preaching the gospel of the kingdom.
Jesus was moved with compassion for the crowds because they were harassed and helpless, like a boat without an anchor.
Jesus told His disciples the harvest is plentiful but the workers are few, so they should ask the Lord of the harvest to send workers.
Jesus called His twelve disciples and gave them authority over unclean spirits and every disease and sickness.
The list includes Matthew the fisherman, and it ends with Judas Iscariot, who betrayed Jesus.
